summary: This page is the Doxygen-generated reference for the Ros Camera Plugin in the gazebo_plugins package, documenting the GazeboRosCamera controller. The controller collects data from a Gazebo camera sensor, populates a libgazebo camera interface, and publishes a ROS sensor_msgs::Image on the topic named by imageTopicName. It is meant to be used only as a child of a camera sensor, and the page includes an example XML configuration.
one_line: Doxygen reference for the GazeboRosCamera plugin, which publishes camera sensor images as ROS sensor_msgs::Image messages.
key_facts: The Ros Camera Plugin Controller is documented under the group Gazebo ROS Dynamic Plugins in the gazebo_plugins package.
The GazeboRosCamera controller collects data from a Camera Sensor and populates a libgazebo camera interface.
The GazeboRosCamera controller publishes a ROS sensor_msgs::Image under the field <imageTopicName>.
The controller should only be used as a child of a camera sensor.
The example configuration sets alwaysOn to true.
The example configuration sets updateRate to 15.0.
The example configuration sets imageTopicName to camera_name/image_raw.
The example configuration sets cameraInfoTopicName to camera_name/camera_info.
The example configuration sets frameName to camera_body_name.
The example plugin is named controller-name and uses plugin libgazebo_ros_camera.so.
The example places the controller inside a sensor:camera named camera_sensor, within a body:empty named camera_body_name, within a model:physical named camera_model.
The gazebo_plugins package lists Sachin Chitta, Stu Glaser, and John Hsu as authors.
